items.reason: Entry requires 'Newly diagnosed high-grade glioma with BRAF^V600-mutation'; the manual's own example is 'BRAF V600E + BRAF/MEK inhibitor', and the record states the drugs act by 'blocking BRAF and MEK, respectively', so both candidates are matched.

items.proposed: BRAF eligibility, candidate_matched true, matched_agent 'dabrafenib; trametinib'
items.reason: Same biomarker row; the coders differ only in the matched agent. Trametinib (MEK inhibitor) is mechanistically linked to BRAF V600 per the manual example. candidate_matched_selection is true either way.

C2 lists co-candidates as partners (dabrafenib and trametinib for each other), but C3 counts only agents given concurrently with the candidate, and the record says 'Four weeks after completion of RT, patients receive dabrafenib mesylate PO BID and trametinib dimethyl sulfoxide PO QD', so radiotherapy is not a partner. regimen stays combination because the two candidates are given together.

note: Paediatric/young-adult (3-25 y). Primary outcome candidate_matched_selection=true is not in dispute. D31-C2 settles that co-candidates are listed in combination_partners; D31-C3 drops the preceding radiotherapy (regimen stays combination because dabrafenib and trametinib are given together).
